title_hi: Expectancy–value: अध्ययन वास्तव में क्या मापते हैं?
topic: expectancy beliefs, subjective task value, attainment, intrinsic interest, utility, cost, task choice, persistence, engagement, and performance
unique_angle: Expectancy–value studies measure task-specific beliefs about success and task-specific values or costs, then relate them to observed choices, persistence, engagement, or performance; these measures do not directly reveal a universal private motivation state.
evidence_class: foundational expectancy–value model, peer-reviewed conceptual review, and meta-analysis of expectancy–value constructs in physical education
safety_boundary: Public education only. Expectancy, value, and cost are task-, population-, setting-, and context-bound measures; self-report beliefs are not diagnosis, proof of ability, direct mind reading, or guaranteed predictions of future behavior.

source_ids.citation: Wigfield & Eccles (2000), Expectancy–Value Theory of Achievement Motivation
